hook.name: LootHook
hook.description: Fee-taking hook that skims 1.5% of every swap in ETH. On buys (ETH→token), fees are claimed as ERC-6909 ETH credits in beforeSwap and redeemed in afterSwap or via a permissionless collect(); on sells (token→ETH), fees are taken from the ETH output in afterSwap. Fees are split among token holders (via DividendToken.fundPot), creator, platform, and ops.
